items.title: FROZEN-FRONTIER PRE-MARKET BENCHMARK MARKDOWN: the calendar day advances (08-03 -> 08-04) and the window flips (after-hours -> pre-market) but the completed-daily-bar frontier stays FROZEN at 2026-08-03 (expectedSessionDate unchanged, swing bars 507 -> 507, 287/287 fresh / 0 carried / 0 missing), so the repeated XLY rotate-into does NOT add a distinct bar date (persistence HELD at 3, NOT incremented) even as the live benchmark reference marks DOWN off the prior window's fresh 52-week high.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior same-day 'post-close completed-bar confirmation' pattern (which DID increment persistence when a new 08-03 bar formed). Here the SESSION does NOT roll a new completed bar: between the prior after-hours window (08-03) and this pre-market window the calendar day changed to 2026-08-04 (meta.todayEt 08-03 -> 08-04, marketClosed=false, nextSessionDate 2026-08-04) yet dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate stayed 2026-08-03 and swing bars stayed 507 (287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing), so the identical XLY rotate-into repeats on the SAME 08-03 completed bar and its distinct-completed-bar-date persistence MUST NOT increment — it stays at three dates (07-30, 07-31, 08-03). Simultaneously the deterministic bench/regime layer repriced LOWER while the owner-tool headless reads were carried unchanged: bench SPY 757.67 -> 747.03, pctFrom52wHigh 0 -> -1.4, mom126 10.08 -> 8.21, mom252 21.2 -> 19.05, ma50Dist 1.76 -> 0.38, ma200Dist 8.56 -> 7.12 (maStack still bull-stack; VIX 15.86 band 'VIX 15.9' score 0 unchanged). The 08-03-close options structure carried forward shows the dealer flip at 743.36 (walls 740/758, EM ±3.81, atmIV 13.6%, signedNetGEX +3.287B), so the marked-down live bench (747.03) now sits only ~0.5% above the positive-gamma flip. Breadth (57.53%), vol-sizing forecast (14.5644%, throttle ×1.03), the intraday 08-03 trend-day tape and the swing Double-bottom/Bull-stack all carried UNCHANGED. Signature: a next-calendar-day pre-market re-read that must be counted as the SAME completed bar for persistence (frontier frozen) while the intraday benchmark reference gaps lower toward the dealer flip — the mirror image of the post-close pattern where the frontier advanced and persistence incremented.
items.method: Add a 'frozen-frontier pre-market markdown' composite test that fires when meta.todayEt ADVANCES to a new calendar date AND snapshot.window is a pre-session window (pre-market) AND dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate is UNCHANGED from the prior window AND the swing bar count is UNCHANGED (delta 0) AND freshSymbolCount==symbolCount with carriedSymbolCount==0 and missingSymbolCount==0. Assert FOUR joint conditions: (1) FRONTIER FROZEN = expectedSessionDate and swing bars both unchanged across a calendar-day advance, so any repeated rotation leg MUST NOT increment its distinct-completed-bar-date persistence counter (the anti-double-count guard: distinct bar dates, not intraday/inter-window re-runs); (2) BENCH MARKDOWN = the deterministic bench px falls and pctFrom52wHigh turns more negative versus the prior window (757.67 -> 747.03; 0 -> -1.4) while maStack stays bull-stack; (3) OWNER-READ CARRY = the owning-tool headless reads (swing, options-structure, gamma, intraday, vol-sizing, breadth) are unchanged in asOf/values, i.e. the reprice is confined to the live bench/regime layer, not the completed-bar owner reads; (4) FLIP PROXIMITY = the marked-down live bench closes to within a small band above the carried-forward positive-gamma flip (747.03 vs 743.36, ~0.5%). Emit the experimental flag only when (1) holds AND at least two of (2)-(4) co-occur, so an ordinary quiet pre-market re-read (frontier frozen, bench roughly flat) does not trip it and only a genuine same-frontier markdown toward structural levels is surfaced.
